title: Information Security Governance
description: Government entities shall establish governance accountability and oversight for information security

title: Information Security Risk Management
description: Information security risks shall be assessed treated monitored and reviewed

title: Asset Classification
description: Information assets shall be inventoried classified and assigned appropriate protection requirements

title: Logical Access Control
description: Access shall be granted according to business requirements and least privilege

title: Local Data Hosting
description: Government information classified as sensitive shall be hosted in approved UAE locations where required

title: Security Logging
description: Information systems shall generate retain and protect audit logs for security monitoring and investigation

title: Arabic Audit Evidence
description: Audit evidence and regulatory reports shall be made available in Arabic where mandated by the responsible authority

title: National Incident Notification
description: Significant incidents shall be reported to the competent UAE cybersecurity authority or national incident response function

title: Supplier Assurance
description: External service providers shall comply with defined information security requirements and provide assurance evidence

title: Service Continuity
description: Critical information services shall maintain tested continuity and recovery capabilities

title: Technical Vulnerability Management
description: Vulnerabilities shall be identified evaluated and remediated within risk-based timelines

title: Cryptographic Protection
description: Sensitive information shall be encrypted using approved cryptographic methods
